title: अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीले नेपाली लेखाइमा गर्ने त्रुटिको विश्लेषण
nepali: सिकारुले विभिन्न खालका त्रुटि गर्दछन् । त्रुटि भाषाका चारओटै सिप सुनाइ, बोलाइ, पढाइ र लेखाइमा हुन्छन् । त्रुटि मातृभाषामा मात्र होइन, दोस्रो वा अन्य भाषा सिकाइका क््रmममा पनि हुन्छन् । सिकारुले कुुन प्रकृतिका त्रुटि गर्दछन् । ती त्रुटि के कारणले र कसरी हुन्छन् । तिनको निराकरणका उपाय के के हुन् भनी अध्ययन विश्लेषण गर्ने पद्धति त्रुटिविश्लेषण हो । त्रुटिको अध्ययनबाट सिकारुका ज्ञानको स्तर पत्ता लगाउन सकिन्छ । प्रस्तुत लेख अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीले नेपाली लेखाइमा गर्ने त्रुटिको विश्लेषणमा केन्द्रित छ । यसको मुख्य उद्देश्य अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीले नेपाली लेखाइमा गर्ने त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउनुु रहेको छ । अध्ययनका क्रममा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गर्दा लिखित रूपमा स्तन्त्र वर्णन गराइएको छ । अवधी भाषाका बारेमा पूर्व प्रकाशित पुस्तक, पत्रपत्रिका, पुस्तकालयीय कार्यको उपयोग गरिएको छ । तथ्याङ्क विश्लेषण गर्दा वर्णनात्मक, तुलनात्मक र विश्लेषणात्मक विधि प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यसरी यस लेखमा विषयपरिचय, त्रुटिविश्लेषणको सैद्धान्तिक आधार, समस्या, उद्देश्य, विधि र प्रक्रिया, अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीका नेपाली लेखाइगत त्रुटिको विश्लेषण गरी अन्त्यमा निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुुत गरिएको छ । अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीलाई नेपाली लेखाइमा कठिनाइ भएको, शब्दभण्डार, शब्दोच्चारणका तरिका र लय भिन्न भएकाले नेपाली भाषाका सुनाइ, बोलाइ, पढाइ तथा लेखाइमा त्रुुटि हुुने गरेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । अवधी भाषी विद्यार्थीहरूको भाषिक विकासका लागि त्रुटिको पहिचान गरी निराकरण गरिनुपर्छ । कक्षामा बहुभाषिक शिक्षकको ब्यवस्था गरी मातृभाषाका शैक्षिक सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी लेखन अभ्यास गराउनुपर्दछ । पाठको उद्देश्यअनुरूप पाठ्यक्रम, पाठ्यपुस्तक र शिक्षक निर्देशिकाको प्रयोग गरी योजनाबद्ध शिक्षण गर्नुपर्दछ ।
american_english: Learners make various kinds of errors. Errors occur in all four language skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Errors occur not only in the mother tongue but also during the learning of a second or other language. What kinds of errors do learners make? What causes those errors and how do they occur? The method of studying and analyzing what the remedies for those errors are is error analysis. The level of a learner's knowledge can be determined through the study of errors. The present article focuses on the analysis of errors made by Awadhi-speaking students in Nepali writing. Its main objective is to identify the errors made by Awadhi-speaking students in Nepali writing. During data collection, written independent descriptions were elicited. Previously published books, journals and newspapers, and library work were used regarding the Awadhi language. Descriptive, comparative and analytical methods were used in analyzing the data. Thus, in this article, a subject introduction, the theoretical basis of error analysis, the problem, the objective, the method and procedure, an analysis of the Nepali writing errors of Awadhi-speaking students, and finally a conclusion have been presented. It has been concluded that Awadhi-speaking students have difficulty in Nepali writing, and that differences in vocabulary, pronunciation methods and rhythm cause errors in the listening, speaking, reading and writing of the Nepali language. For the linguistic development of Awadhi-speaking students, errors must be identified and remedied. A multilingual teacher should be arranged in the classroom, mother-tongue educational materials should be collected, and writing practice should be given. According to the objective of the lesson, planned teaching should be carried out using the curriculum, textbook and teacher's guide.

informal_english: Learners make all sorts of mistakes. Mistakes show up in all four language skills: listening, speaking, reading and writing. And it's not just in your mother tongue; they happen when you're learning a second or another language too. What kinds of mistakes do learners make? What causes them and how do they happen? The way we study and analyse all of that, figuring out how to fix those mistakes, is what's called error analysis. By studying mistakes you can work out how much a learner actually knows. This article zooms in on the mistakes Awadhi-speaking students make in Nepali writing. The main goal is to pick up on those mistakes. When data was collected, written descriptions were gathered. Previously published books, journals and newspapers, and library work were used on the Awadhi language. Descriptive, comparative and analytical methods were used to analyse the data. So the article walks you through a subject introduction, the theory behind error analysis, the problem, the objective, the method and procedure, an analysis of the Nepali writing mistakes of Awadhi-speaking students, and finally a conclusion. The conclusion drawn is that Awadhi-speaking students find Nepali writing hard, and that differences in vocabulary, pronunciation and rhythm lead to mistakes in listening, speaking, reading and writing Nepali. For Awadhi-speaking students to develop linguistically, those mistakes need to be spotted and fixed. A multilingual teacher should be put in the classroom, mother-tongue learning materials should be gathered, and writing practice should be given. Teaching should be planned out using the curriculum, textbook and teacher's guide, depending on what the lesson aims to achieve.
